messages:
Kai: Odd one: onboarding sample started dropping x-request-id only when LOG_LEVEL=debug and REDACT_SENSITIVE=1. Non-debug levels look fine. Saw this on Linux. :thinking:
Nora: I can repro. Happens with both node and python samples, which suggests SDK behavior not sampleapp-specific.
Ben: Any difference with OTEL on/off? Iirc OTEL changes ordering sometimes.
Kai: Good call. It only shows up when OTEL integration is enabled and when HTTP client retries occur. If you disable OTEL headers propagation the id stays in logs.
Satya: Minimal repro (node):
```js
// order matters
app.use(telemetry.redactHook())
app.use(telemetry.otelHook())
app.use(telemetry.logHook())
```
Satya: With that order, when a retry happens the redaction middleware runs before otelHook and maskHeader mutates the header object in a way that subsequent retries rebuild a header map without the key. So sometimes the header is missing entirely rather than masked.
Nora: That's interesting — our redactHook was implemented to shallow-delete headers matching denylist then re-add masked values in a follow-up step. That sounds destructive across the retry path.
Ben: For a quick local fix I changed redactHook to not delete keys; instead it sets header to `REDACTED-{hash}` synchronously and marks `req.state._redacted=true`. That preserved the key through replayed requests.
Kai: I also saw spans leaking the raw guid into OTLP if OTEL_PROPAGATE_HEADERS=1 with LOG_LEVEL=trace. OTEL hook reads headers early and copies to span attributes before the redactHook ran. So two issues: destructive redaction + early attribute capture.
Satya: Proposed plan: 1) make redaction non-destructive (mask in-place), 2) update otelHook to read from a canonical accessor `getHeader(req, 'x-request-id')` which consults redaction state if present, 3) add a test that simulates an HTTP client replay preserving header keys.
Nora: Agree. Low-risk immediate step: change redactHook in sampleapps to mask in-place. Longer term: SDK change to canonical accessor and CI assertion.
Ben: I'll open a PR for the non-destructive redaction now and add a unit. Also adding a middleware ordering note to onboarding docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/pull/309
telemetry-bot: New issue TW-8055 created: "redactHook deletes x-request-id during retry replay when OTEL enabled" 1 linked to PR #309.
onboard-bot: Recommend holding hosted samples rollout until non-destructive redaction merged.
Kai: Thanks — I'll attach a small curl loop and the span export that showed the leak to TW-8055.
Satya: One more optional mitigation: make logHook fallback to `req.headers['x-request-id']` if ctx accessor empty, so logs still show something even if OTEL race occurs. But prefer addressing root cause.
Nora: Good call. I'll add fallback to logHook as a belt-and-suspenders fix behind a feature flag.
Ben: Will include changelog note and migration guidance.
Kai: Great. Thanks all. :coffee:
